newsitem.title: USA: Salomon says to restate Q4 on Basis sale.
newsitem.headline: Salomon says to restate Q4 on Basis sale.

text.p: Salomon Inc said it will restate fourth quarter results to a net loss of $62 million, or $0.71 per primary and diluted share, to reflect an aftertax loss of $290 million from the sale of its Basis Petroleum Inc unit to Valero Energy Corp.
The restated loss compared with a profit of $168 million, or $1.32 per diluted share and $1.42 per primary share, a year before.
Salomon posted fourth quarter operating income of $234 million, or $1.88 per diluted share, before the Basis deal, versus $187 million, or $1.32, a year ago.
Salomon said earlier Monday that its board approved a letter of intent to sell all of the stock of Basis to Valero for $485 million in stock and cash.
